title: Material slider and presentation contracts
summary: Source-backed slider, wrapper, select presentation and toggle registration.

facts.claim: FormlyMatSliderModule registers slider with the form-field wrapper. It selects FormlyFieldMDCSlider when Number(VERSION.major) from @angular/cdk is at least 15, otherwise the legacy FormlyFieldSlider.
facts.context: slider registration module CDK legacy MDC version 15
limits: The selection branch is not a tested Angular/Material compatibility matrix.
facts.source_quote: FormlyMatSliderModule registers slider with the form-field wrapper. It selects FormlyFieldMDCSlider when Number(VERSION.major) from @angular/cdk is at least 15, otherwise the legacy FormlyFieldSlider. [K33](sources.md#k33)

facts.claim: The legacy slider binds formControl on mat-slider. The MDC slider binds formControl on its input matSliderThumb; its slider template forwards min, max, step, displayWith and discrete from props.thumbLabel || props.discrete.
facts.context: slider legacy MDC matSliderThumb formControl min max step discrete
limits: These are renderer bindings, not proof of every browser interaction or Material-version combination.
facts.source_quote: The legacy slider binds formControl on mat-slider. The MDC slider binds formControl on its input matSliderThumb; its slider template forwards min, max, step, displayWith and discrete from props.thumbLabel || props.discrete. [K53](sources.md#k53) [K54](sources.md#k54)

facts.claim: Material form-field props prefix, suffix, textPrefix and textSuffix are TemplateRef values rendered with a context containing field. hintStart and hintEnd accept strings or TemplateRef values. The start hint uses truthy props.description before props.hintStart.
facts.context: prefix suffix textPrefix textSuffix hints description template string
limits: Do not pass raw text as a TemplateRef prefix/suffix; these declarations do not forward every Material input.
facts.source_quote: Material form-field props prefix, suffix, textPrefix and textSuffix are TemplateRef values rendered with a context containing field. hintStart and hintEnd accept strings or TemplateRef values. The start hint uses truthy props.description before props.hintStart. [K17](sources.md#k17)

facts.claim: The Material form-field wrapper binds props.appearance, props.floatLabel and props.subscriptSizing, and binds color to props.color with a nullish fallback of primary. subscriptSizing is declared fixed or dynamic.
facts.context: appearance floatLabel color subscriptSizing fixed dynamic
limits: Allowed Material appearance and float-label types come from the installed Material dependency; this is not a compatibility guarantee.
facts.source_quote: The Material form-field wrapper binds props.appearance, props.floatLabel and props.subscriptSizing, and binds color to props.color with a nullish fallback of primary. subscriptSizing is declared fixed or dynamic. [K17](sources.md#k17)

facts.claim: The Material wrapper disables the built-in mat-form-field required marker and renders its own asterisk inside its label when props.required is truthy and props.hideRequiredMarker is not true. The label itself requires a truthy props.label and props.hideLabel not true.
facts.context: required asterisk hideRequiredMarker hideLabel label presentation
limits: Hiding the marker is presentation, not removal of required validation. The inspected wrapper does not declare a showAsterisk prop for optional fields.
facts.source_quote: The Material wrapper disables the built-in mat-form-field required marker and renders its own asterisk inside its label when props.required is truthy and props.hideRequiredMarker is not true. The label itself requires a truthy props.label and props.hideLabel not true. [K17](sources.md#k17)

facts.claim: Material select reads aria-label from props.attributes. For aria-labelledby it uses a truthy props.attributes["aria-labelledby"] value, otherwise the associated form-field label ID.
facts.context: select aria-label aria-labelledby accessible name attributes label
limits: These bindings do not certify accessible naming in every layout or browser.
facts.source_quote: Material select reads aria-label from props.attributes. For aria-labelledby it uses a truthy props.attributes["aria-labelledby"] value, otherwise the associated form-field label ID. [K14](sources.md#k14)

facts.claim: Material select forwards props.panelClass to mat-select panelClass. Its inspected template does not bind a readonly input.
facts.context: select overlay panelClass host class readonly
limits: A field host class is not automatically the overlay panelClass. The absence of a readonly binding does not justify treating disabled as equivalent for validity or submitted values.
facts.source_quote: Material select forwards props.panelClass to mat-select panelClass. Its inspected template does not bind a readonly input. [K14](sources.md#k14)

facts.claim: FormlyMatToggleModule registers toggle with FormlyFieldToggle and the form-field wrapper.
facts.context: toggle registration FormlyMatToggleModule FormlyFieldToggle secondary module
limits: The aggregate module does not register every secondary type; see existing aggregate-membership evidence. This record does not qualify every Material release.
facts.source_quote: FormlyMatToggleModule registers toggle with FormlyFieldToggle and the form-field wrapper. [K81](sources.md#k81)
